_note: Upgrade offers (Yusuf's pick 2026-10-22): a blueprint draft may offer one of these as its deepening offer (Yusuf 2026-10-26: one offer a draft builds on what the town has, sim/build_hand.gd) for a building the town has standing. Taking it spends the draft and changes that building for the rest of the run, every one of it, built or still to come. add = numbers added to the building's data in data/buildings.json, by key; a dotted key reaches inside (lodging.beds). Each upgrade can be taken once. rarity = data/rarity.json (offer weight). sim/build_hand.gd (offers, draft_upgrade), RunState.take_upgrade.

raised_beds.name: Raised beds
raised_beds.text: Garden patches grow 1 more food every dawn.

tall_posts.name: Tall posts
tall_posts.text: Watch posts see and shoot 40 farther, and stand 30 sturdier.

feather_beds.name: Feather beds
feather_beds.text: Heroes in the mead hall rest half again as fast.

healing_spring.name: Healing spring
healing_spring.text: Heroes in the spirit shrine heal twice as fast.

skinning_knives.name: Skinning knives
skinning_knives.text: The hunting lodge pays 2 more shells a beast and skins 1 more hide.

iron_bands.name: Banded gates
iron_bands.text: Gates take half again as many blows to break.

sparring_posts.name: Sparring posts
sparring_posts.text: Heroes drilling at the training yard learn twice as fast.

second_kennel.name: Bigger kennel
second_kennel.text: The kennel keeps hounds for 2 more heroes.

bright_lamps.name: Seer's lamps
bright_lamps.text: Every dawn shows yet another card.

deep_kegs.name: Deep kegs
deep_kegs.text: Bands form with 1 more fewer member.

forest_paths.name: Forest paths
forest_paths.text: The forester tends plants half again as far.

practised_tanners.name: Practised tanners
practised_tanners.text: Hide racks work twice as fast.

practised_carvers.name: Practised carvers
practised_carvers.text: Bone carvers work twice as fast.

practised_smokers.name: Practised smokers
practised_smokers.text: Smoke huts work twice as fast.

coppicing.name: Coppicing
coppicing.text: Foresters cut back and replant: the plants they tend regrow twice as fast.

deep_quarry.name: Deep quarry
deep_quarry.text: The stone-layers dig the rocks and flint pits round the yard deeper: each dawn they regrow a quarter of their size.

game_warden.name: Game warden
game_warden.text: The lodge's warden keeps the wild land round it: brush, groves and berry thickets within reach regrow a tenth of their size each dawn.

crop_rotation.name: Crop rotation
crop_rotation.text: Fields rest in turn and come back richer: 1 more food from each field every dawn.
